subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘CANADA’ is written as ‘XZMZWZ’ and ‘AFRICA’ is written as ‘ZUIRXZ’. How will ‘DEPRESSION’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is "**the opposite of the letter."**

For, ‘CANADA is written as XZMZWZ’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1579c6d976bc3ce64abc350fab4d6e9ed7754dbbb1468e107f273415de3d6b91.png] 

For, 'AFRICA is written as ZUIRXZ',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5a05f5472db3df41bdb866fb58dfebca01fe2998bcc0139d8be14f39abdbbcd.png] 

Similarly, for **'DEPRESSION'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2ad0734d45bcaaa4cc44124b1cabed522d824e101a1c34675e73faaee2498ad.png] 

So, **'****DEPRESSION**' will be written as '**WVKIVHHRLM****'**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
